members.name: EnsurePages
members.description: Guarantees that contains at least one page.

members.name: SnapToGrid
members.description: Snap all node positions and sizes to the given grid size.

members.name: ActivePageIndex
members.description: Index of the page currently being edited.

members.name: LastUsedEdgeStyle
members.description: Most recently applied edge style (stroke, arrow, routing preferences…). When a new edge is created, this snapshot is cloned onto it so the style sticks across edges until the user edits one through the properties panel. `null` → use built-in defaults.

members.name: Pages
members.description: All pages in the diagram. The first page is used by default.

members.name: Title
members.description: Human-readable title shown in the editor toolbar.

members.name: Version
members.description: Schema version. Bumped on breaking changes to enable migration.
